name: Breakfast with Santa at Gardner Village
when_note: December 4, 5, 11, 12, 18, 19, 21, 22 and 23, 2026; seatings at 9 AM, 11 AM and 1 PM
cost: $36 per person; children under 2 sit on a lap free
paras: Gardner Village in West Jordan serves Breakfast with Santa at Mill Plaza, next to Archibald's Restaurant, on nine dates from December 4 to 23, 2026. Seatings start at 9 AM, 11 AM and 1 PM.

Tickets are $36 per person, and children under 2 can sit on a lap for free. The buffet includes chocolate chip pancakes, scrambled eggs, bacon and hot chocolate, with music, dances and activities led by elf helpers and a visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
tip: Book a seating ahead of time, since each date has three set times.

name: Breakfast with Santa at the Little America Hotel
host: Little America Hotel Salt Lake City
address: 500 S. Main St., Salt Lake City, UT 84101
when_note: Sundays, December 6, 13 and 20, 2026; seatings from 9 AM to 12:30 PM
cost: $79 adults; $39 children 3 to 12; free for ages 2 and under (plus tax and a 20 percent service charge)
paras: The Little America Hotel in downtown Salt Lake City hosts Breakfast with Santa on Sundays, December 6, 13 and 20, 2026, with seatings from 9 AM to 12:30 PM.

Tickets are $79 for adults and $39 for children 3 to 12, and children 2 and under are free. Prices do not include tax and a 20 percent service charge. The buffet has omelets, a crepe station and a children's station, and each table gets a professional photo with Santa and Mrs. Claus, live piano music and coloring pages.
tip: Reserve early because tables are prepaid, and cancel at least 48 hours ahead to avoid a fee.

name: Breakfast with Santa at the Grand America Hotel
address: 555 S. Main St., Salt Lake City, UT 84111
when_note: November 28 and December 5, 12, 18, 19, 21 and 22, 2026; seatings from 10 AM to 11:30 AM or 12 PM
cost: $65 adults; $35 children 3 to 11; free for ages 2 and under
paras: The Grand America Hotel in Salt Lake City serves Breakfast with Santa on seven dates: November 28 and December 5, 12, 18, 19, 21 and 22, 2026. Seatings run from 10 AM to 11:30 AM or 12 PM.

Tickets are $65 for adults and $35 for children 3 to 11, and children 2 and under are free. The expansive breakfast buffet comes with singing, story time and photos with Mr. and Mrs. Claus, and reservations are required.
tip: Reservations are required, so book before you plan the morning.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's Salt Lake City
address: 140 S. Rio Grande St., Salt Lake City, UT 84101
cost: Breakfast only from $27.94; Santa's Ultimate Workshop ticket from $33.01 (plus fees)
paras: Dave & Buster's in downtown Salt Lake City hosts Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to 12 PM. Breakfast includes pancakes, eggs, bacon, fresh fruit and unlimited beverages.

The Holly Jolly Breakfast Only ticket starts at $27.94, and Santa's Ultimate Workshop ticket starts at $33.01, both plus fees. Kids get a VIP meet and greet with Santa, a personal photo and take-home holiday crafts, and the workshop ticket adds a $10 Power Card with three hours of unlimited play on non-redemption games.
tip: Pick the workshop ticket if you want arcade time after breakfast.

name: Ogden's Breakfast with Santa at Union Station
paras: Ogden City hosts Breakfast with Santa at Ogden Union Station on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.
Tickets are $35 per person. Families enjoy a breakfast and a meet and greet with Santa, and the city office at 801-629-8214 can confirm ticket details.
tip: Call the number on the city page if you need to confirm tickets.

name: Davis Conference Center's Breakfast with Santa
paras: The Davis Conference Center in Layton hosts its Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 8:45 AM to 12 PM at 1651 N. 700 W.
Tickets are $51.99 for adults and $41.99 for children 4 to 12. Tickets are sold in advance online through the venue.
tip: Buy tickets ahead of time, since the event is sold by advance ticket.

name: Pioneer Christmas at the Provo Pioneer Village
when_note: Friday December 11, Saturday December 12 and Monday December 14, 2026, 5 to 8 PM
paras: The Provo Pioneer Village holds an old-fashioned Pioneer Christmas on December 11, 12 and 14, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM each evening, and admission is free.

Families enjoy live music, crafters, storytelling and visits with Father Christmas. Kids get a small gift, a photo with Mrs. Claus, a fishing pond with prizes and fun pioneer games, and the first 30 families each evening receive a free battery-operated candle.
tip: Arrive early to be among the first 30 families for the free candle.

name: Victorian Christmas at the Old Town Hall
paras: The Pleasant Grove Historic Preservation Commission hosts its fourth annual Victorian Christmas at the Old Town Hall, 105 S. 100 E., on Monday, December 7, 2026, from 6 to 8 PM. The event is free.
This year's theme is Pleasant Grove's first Christmases, so families see what Christmas was like in the 1860s through period crafts, food and live music. Santa also pops in to visit with the kids.
tip: Plan on about an hour to see the crafts and meet Santa.
